goal: Fix #3264: guarded-lane merges push as github-actions, and GitHub starts no push workflow for that token, so sync.yml never fired after a guarded merge. Add workflow_dispatch to sync.yml and have the guarded merge workflow dispatch it on main right after a proven merge.
dispatcher: Albert's own chat instruction: "spin up a sub-agent to do #3264"
worker: Claude sub-agent, dispatched from chat 3886eb83-7824-4477-a257-dd3adfd80d03 on edge-dev
prohibited_actions: Never touch a database, preview or production target.
Never widen guarded-merge permissions beyond actions: write, scoped to this job, for the dispatch.
Never make the sync dispatch fire before the merge step is proven successful.
Never route this to the structure/schema orchestrator; it changes no database shape.
assumptions: sync.yml's existing concurrency group (sync-shared-db, cancel-in-progress: false) safely serializes a manual dispatch against an overlapping ordinary push; no concurrency change is needed.

origin/main moved during exact-head review with unrelated, non-documentation changes; a merge-from-main (7cc559b2355ca87ed354807a0300b9b86b2623f1) was required. The reviewed non-.agent diff stayed byte-identical across the merge, so the durable APPROVE verdict recorded at ea4d3ae15b7d8bdd596a1df28baeadb7e6c4fc28 carries forward.
stop_conditions: Stop and report if the consumer sync still does not start after a guarded merge lands through this fix.
Stop and report on any gate refusal; never weaken a guard to proceed.
